subject: Acme Systems - VM evidence bundle and SLA acknowledgement
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jbloom@acmesystems.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: GRC Team <grc@acmesystems.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: VM cadence and proof for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Neha,

We're completing the SIG and preparing for our SOC 2 refresh. The Acme GRC team asked for a concise package covering your vulnerability management program specific to hosted services used by Acme customers:

- scan cadence (internal + external) and detection coverage
- SLA for critical/important CVEs (time-to-remediate targets)
- representative evidence (scan exports, patch manifests, and a short signed attestation)

Can you send a bundle we can hand to our auditors by EOD Wednesday 7/29? If there are any gaps we can accept an interim attestation + plan, but we need dates and owners.

Also: is there a single link to the artifact bundle (Drive or secure transfer) you prefer we use?

Thanks,
Jared
Jared Bloom
Sr. GRC Analyst | Acme Systems
security@acmesystems.com

--
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jbloom@acmesystems.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM cadence and proof for SOC 2 / SIG

Jared — thanks for the clear ask. We can get a handoff bundle together by Wednesday. Quick outline of what we'll provide:

1) Scan cadence and tooling summary (weekly authenticated agent scans + daily external vulnerability scans; centralized tracker).
2) CSV export of the last 90 days of scans for the prod fleet (sample of hosts and image hashes).
3) Patch manifest showing applied fixes and rollback notes for high/critical fixes.
4) A short attestation PDF attesting to our CVE SLA commitments for customer-facing services.

Kimberly is looped for any SOC2 language; David will assemble the artifacts and the signed PDF.

Delivery plan:
- Tue 7/27: David posts the Drive folder link with preliminary exports and the patch manifest.
- Wed 7/28 morning: final attestation PDF (signed) + consolidated CSVs.
- Wed 7/28 afternoon: short 30-min review call if you want a quick walkthrough.

We will include a DocuSign link for the attestation so your auditors have a signed artifact. If you prefer an S3 transfer instead of Drive, let me know.

Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0132

--
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jbloom@acmesystems.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: VM evidence bundle for Acme (prelim)

Hi Jared / Neha,

I've uploaded the preliminary artifact bundle to Drive (link below). Attached here are the export stubs; full CSV/XLSX are in the folder.

Attachments included (stubs attached to this mail):
- [attachment: scan_summary_Q2-2026.csv] (sample of authenticated internal scans + external scans; truncated rows for PI)
- [attachment: patch_manifest_Q2-2026.xlsx] (list of patches applied, CVE mappings, deploy runbooks)
- [attachment: cve_attestation_acme_2026-07.pdf] (draft attestation; will be signed via DocuSign)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmeVMArtifacts
DocuSign for final attestation: https://app.docusign.com/#!/documents/47b3-acme-attest

Key notes on SLAs and cadence:
- Scan cadence: authenticated agent scans nightly; external authenticated scans weekly; critical CVE detection alerts route to on-call within 15 minutes.
- Remediation SLA (customer-facing services): critical CVEs (CVSS >= 9.0) – 72 hours to mitigation plan and either patch or compensating control; important (CVSS 7.0–8.9) – 14 days to mitigation plan.
- Exceptions and compensating controls are documented in the manifest column "mitigation_status".

We redacted IP addresses in the CSV preview for this email; full artifacts in Drive include a redaction index for auditor review.

If you want a specific mapping for CVE 2026-3456 (mentioned in a recent questionnaire), see the patch_manifest tab named "2026-3456": remedied on 2026-07-20 in canary, full rollout 2026-07-24.

Let us know if you'd prefer we bundle the raw scanner logs as well — that can be added to the folder (they're larger and SFTP/S3 is recommended).

-David
David Kim
Sr. Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwoodinference.com

--
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jbloom@acmesystems.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VM evidence bundle for Acme (final)

Jared — thanks for the quick review earlier. Per David's upload, we finalized the bundle and completed DocuSign for the attestation. Short answers to the two outstanding items you asked about: 

1) CVE 2026-3456 — confirmed remediated; full rollout completed 2026-07-24, rollback plan documented in patch_manifest_Q2-2026.xlsx (sheet: 2026-3456).
2) Auditors wanting raw scanner logs — we can provide an S3 transfer; we'll redaction-index the logs and provide hashes for provenance.

Final artifacts (same as attachments listed): scan_summary_Q2-2026.csv, patch_manifest_Q2-2026.xlsx, cve_attestation_acme_2026-07.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmeVMArtifacts
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/#!/documents/47b3-acme-attest

If this satisfies Acme's intake, please reply with acceptance and we'll mark the SIG response as closed on our side. If you want the 30-min walkthrough, propose two windows (Thu 7/29 10–11am PT or Fri 7/30 1–2pm PT).

-Neha
